description: Adversaries may look for folders and drives accessible on remote systems as a means of identifying sources of information to gather as a precursor for Collection and to identify potential systems of interest for Lateral Movement.
artifacts: SMB Tree Connect requests to IPC$ and ADMIN$ shares
SMB Tree Connect requests to named shares (C$, D$, etc.)
SMB2/3 session establishment and authentication attempts
NetBIOS Session Service (NBSS) traffic on TCP/139
NFS mount requests and RPC calls (TCP/2049, UDP/2049)
RPC endpoint mapper queries (TCP/135) for SMB-related services
SMB enumeration commands (net view, net share, smbclient -L)
SMB2/3 tree connect responses indicating share availability
